content:
viv: Quick: users keep asking why compare doesn’t show current filters. Bug or intended?

sam: Intent was snapshot. But agree it’s confusing.

clare: UX fix idea: small label in header saying "Snapshot (filters at open)" plus a "Sync" button.

mike: Backend safe: sync should re-run filters against pinned ids and add any new matches without removing pins.

clare: Also change "Lock version" -> "Pin version" across modals. Users thought "lock" was destructive.

research-bot: Research note: participants prefer "Resync" wording. Recommend tooltip: "Resync applies current catalog filters; pinned models are preserved."

viv: Decision: add header label + Resync button (default snapshot), update copy to "Pin version"; add aria-live for updates. Owners: sam + clare.

sam: Will ship small toggle + aria announcements; will include unit tests.

mike: I'll add API route to compute updated list. Throttle to 1s.

viv: Thanks, throwing this into the sprint.
